title: Equationer Timed Algebra Exercise
description: Equationer Timed Algebra Exercise. 3 recovered saves.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: EQUATIONER
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, exact length and end marker; exact independent left/right payload match
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
2 AT=100000
5 CLS
7 GOSUB 20000
10 READ X1,Y1,X2,Y2:IFX1=-1 THEN X1=OX:Y1=OY
15 IF X1=-999 THEN 100
30 OX=X2:OY=Y2
40 GOSUB1000
50 GOTO 10
100 PRINT@448+34+128,"EQUATIONER";
110 IF INKEY$=""THEN110
120 CLS
130 X=RND(15):P1=RND(5):P2=RND(5):A1=RND(6):A2=P1*X+A1-P2*X:IFP1=P2 THEN X=-999
